info.title: CareOps Intelligence API
info.description: Hospital Operations & Performance Intelligence. All figures are computed by a deterministic metrics engine; AI agents only interpret aggregates.

get.summary: Liveness probe
get.description: Returns 200 while the process is running. Does not touch the database.

get.summary: Readiness probe
get.description: Returns 200 when the database answers `SELECT 1`, otherwise 503.

post.description: Creates a **manager** account. Passwords must be 12-128 characters, not a common or breached password, and not contain the email name. The first admin is seeded from environment variables, never through this endpoint.
Returns a 15-minute access token in the body and sets a rotating refresh token in an `httpOnly`, `Secure`, `SameSite=Strict` cookie scoped to `/api/v1/auth`. Errors are deliberately generic.
Exchanges the refresh cookie for a new access token and a new refresh cookie. Re-using an already-rotated refresh token revokes the entire session family.
Revokes the refresh-token family server-side and clears the cookie.

post.summary: Upload and ingest a healthcare dataset (.xlsx or 5 .csv files)
post.description: Validates file extensions and magic-byte signatures, rejects macros and formulas, cleans strings and dates, quarantines invalid rows with structured reasons, derives `doctors`, `suppliers`, and `vendors` dimensions, masks phone numbers to the last 4 digits, and loads everything in a single database transaction. Requires role `manager` or `admin`.
